description: AXAYEG crystallizes in the tetragonal crystal system with space group P 42/n. From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 6 O neighbors; Zn3 (Zn) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table. Article card reports molecular formula Eu4Zn6(μ6-O)L4(CH3COO)6(NO3)4(CH3OH)4(H2O)2·4CH3CN (L = 2-(hydroxymethyl)-2-(pyridin-4-yl)-1,3-propanediol trianion); empirical formula Eu4Zn6O43N12C60H86. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 μ6-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
